translations.web: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.
translations.bsb: So I went down to the potter’s house and saw him working at the wheel.
translations.kjv: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
